purpose: Identify actual local RETURN-x3 response and component risk, then optionally select one new registered grid action. No pooled old different-Trial GP, no old scalar score, no safety-confidence calibration claim.
scope: one known-heavy engineering T3 OUT0 live parent inside the actual T2 H150 child; original full H150 policy, RETURN modal x3 only
prerequisites_before_any_fit: All registered T3 roles B/H150/ZERO_MODAL/ILC_ENABLED_G025/ILC_ENABLED_G010/ILC_HISTORY_DISABLED/FIXED_X3_MINUS025/FIXED_X3_PLUS025 completed and joined, or explicit identical-frozen-action alias to a completed raw execution; failed/partial cost records retained
B, H150, zero, -0.25 and +0.25 all original complete qualified and scorer/receipt/R2 PASS
H150 full components really accepted, activated and own positive native steps
zero exact original trace/native/receipt raw equivalence to H150, recomputed by unchanged compare_raw and bound to source/raw SHA

Both signed x3 interventions have at least one nonzero accepted/activated/positive receipt target change, every proposed nonzero modal target has that execution evidence, selected target equals accepted proposed target, and actual issued reference differs from zero at common real control timestamps
All child full snapshot hashes and case/config/scorer/source/ACTIVATION identities match one live T3 parent; owner still quiescent at that exact OUT0 snapshot before original control advances
JF local response exceeds 1e-6 N*s numerical identification resolution; this is not empirical measurement noise
Separate explicit parent fit approval, source/data/contract freeze and remaining original wall/deadline budget
inputs: Only this stage's already completed real child artifacts and original B/H150 references. Old T1/T2/other-patient outcomes and population-prior errors are excluded as training labels. A disabled action's actual T3 outcome may be an action observation, never a population value label.
required_identity: one full live parent snapshot hash
actual action execution and nonzero reference evidence
observation_targets: Each original continuous motion requirement's signed normalized margin relative to same-parent B; model its deviation from H150 and restore H150's absolute margin at prediction
motion_head_details: 45 separate native motion/phase timing/excursion/travel/endpoint/boundary/JM integral/force peak/moment peak/tracking scalar margins for the current protocol; original per-joint requirements and original numerical eps retained. No collapsed worst_ratio target. Phase shape is diagnostic only as in original protocol. Physical/receipt/R2 qualification remains categorical original task gating, not inferred safe from these heads.
eligible_model_labels: Complete, physically valid, scientific-receipt-valid, R2-matched, clean actual intervention outcomes. Motion-ineligible but otherwise complete legal outcomes may contribute negative component margins; partial, failed physical, unactivated/rejected or mixed-fallback response labels cannot be imputed or fit. Their paid attempts remain in exclusions.
duplicate_policy: H150 and raw-equivalent zero collapse to one x=0 point. Any other exact x3 duplicate must agree in paired costs/margins at 1e-8; otherwise ABSTAIN_NONSTATIONARY_DUPLICATE. Explicit aliases add zero samples and zero new physics. B is a separate full policy, never relabeled x3=0.

all_GP.kernel: condition base kernel on f(0)=0; paired deviations anchor exactly at observed H150

models.model_fit: No hyperparameter optimization, seed search, target scaling learned from future data or cross-patient pooling. Independent scalar heads, shared input matrix factorization only; no learned cross-head covariance.
models.linear_quadratic_spread: Heuristic fixed normalized noise/residual floor times ridge design leverage; not calibrated frequentist or Bayesian safety intervals

diagnostics: Signed first/second finite differences at -0.25,0,+0.25 separately for JF/JM/every margin
Action spread, accepted target and actual reference distinction, phase duration changes and exclusions
In-sample and leave-one-nonzero-action-out residuals for all six variants; neither constitutes independent validation or 3-point safety calibration
Strongest actually qualified fixed signed perturbation/H150 and best all-observed qualified action kept separate
Cost-only ranking versus component-margin conservative selection, with explicit gate/model disagreement reasons

selection.exclude: Every already attempted same semantic x3, including failed/partial; all outside registered signed bracket; aliases do not create new points
selection.require: Every model's heuristic upper JF delta is below the best observed qualified delta by >=0.01 N*s, every model's lower absolute motion margin >=0, and every model's upper JM delta <=0. No claim all components improve; report all component predictions.
selection.order: Minimum worst-model JF upper deviation, then maximum minimum component margin, then smaller abs(x3), then smaller x3
selection.no_eligible: ABSTAIN; keep best actually qualified observed action as descriptive comparator, not a new proposal
selection.safety_language: All spreads/constraints are DATA_LIMITED_HEURISTICS. Three points never calibrate a safety probability. Future real candidate must pass unchanged original task/safety/receipt/R2/motion gates.

owner_integration: Call the V2 hook after all predeclared T3 child END/join records, before owner control(b) advances OUT0. Fit/select/freeze while original parent objects stay quiescent. This source supplies no physics entrypoint: a separately reviewed V2 owner must execute a new proposal via the original real fork/START/END/delta/cleanup path. Calling after V1 run_stage returns loses this same-parent opportunity; no cold reconstruction or exited-child restore.

proposed_resources_requires_new_parent_a.future_optional_original_fork: At most one new complete task, original <=180000 native guard / <=600s task timeout, plus real owner/verification cost; separately approved and main-ledger counted. No extra boundary because it is the same T3 OUT0 parent.
